plan.goal: Turn Pocket Ramanujan into a deeply instructional, source-led collection of accessible Ramanujan mathematics.
success_criteria: At least 10 detailed discovery lessons are published.
Every lesson follows the standard lesson template and has verified sources.
Every formula has accessible rendered math and a plain-language interpretation.
Applications are distinguished from later theoretical influence.
Search visibly uses Pagefind and topic navigation remains crawlable.
The production verification suite remains green.
plan.deliverable: A documented editorial, content, navigation, accessibility, and production roadmap in docs/NEXT-STEPS.md.

subgoals.description: Define and enforce a detailed lesson editorial standard.
subgoals.success_test: Checklist and content schema support complete instructional lessons.

subgoals.description: Expand the collection from three pilots to at least ten lessons.
subgoals.success_test: Ten source-backed lessons build and render without math errors.

subgoals.description: Make navigation support learning progression and prerequisites.
subgoals.success_test: Guided, topic, difficulty, related, and prerequisite navigation are crawlable.
Visible Pagefind search and keyboard/screen-reader checks pass.

subgoals.description: Harden editorial contribution and deployment workflows.
subgoals.success_test: Correction, review, deployment, sitemap, and indexing workflows are documented.

tasks.description: Create the lesson template and editorial review checklist.
tasks.expected_output: A versioned template/checklist used by every future lesson.

tasks.description: Review and deepen the three pilot lessons against the template.
tasks.expected_output: Reviewed pilot content with factual, attribution, and pedagogy corrections.

tasks.description: Research and source the next seven lessons.
tasks.expected_output: Source packets and outlines for circle method, Rogers–Ramanujan identities, tau, continued fractions, modular equations, mock theta functions, and gamma approximations.

tasks.description: Write and publish the next seven detailed lessons.
tasks.expected_output: Seven validated Markdown lessons with examples, proof sketches, applications/influence, and sources.

tasks.description: Add prerequisites, topic landing pages, and expanded guided navigation.
tasks.expected_output: Crawlable learning paths and related-topic navigation.

tasks.description: Wire visible search directly to Pagefind and improve filters.
tasks.expected_output: Pagefind-backed search with topic, difficulty, and empty-state behavior.

tasks.description: Run accessibility, link, math-rendering, and production quality review.
tasks.expected_output: Review report and fixes for critical/important findings.

tasks.description: Connect GitHub/Vercel automation and submit the sitemap for indexing.
tasks.expected_output: Automatic deploy workflow, verified canonical domain, and Search Console submission instructions completed.

milestones.name: Ten-lesson library
milestones.verification: Ten lessons build, render, and pass content validation.

milestones.name: Learning navigation
milestones.verification: Guided/category navigation and Pagefind search pass browser tests.

milestones.name: Production-ready release
milestones.verification: All checks pass, deployment is automatic, and sitemap is submitted.

risks.risk: Some Ramanujan attributions or modern applications are easy to overstate.
risks.mitigation: Use primary/annotated sources and label later proofs or influence explicitly.

risks.risk: Writing seven detailed lessons becomes a large editorial effort.
risks.mitigation: Ship in batches of three and require the template before adding more topics.

risks.risk: Search UI diverges from the generated Pagefind index.
risks.mitigation: Add browser tests against the production-built Pagefind bundle and retain crawlable fallback links.

risks.risk: Vercel deployment protection or domain changes create an inaccessible canonical URL.
risks.mitigation: Verify public HTTP 200 responses, canonical tags, robots, and sitemap after every production deployment.

open_questions: Whether future lessons should target one broad audience with layers or separate beginner/intermediate tracks.
Whether to add illustrations or interactive visualizations after the ten-lesson milestone.
Whether a custom domain is worth purchasing before SEO work begins.
